# Arsalani Rug

> Arsalani Luxury and Modern Rugs (arsalanirug.com) — a family house of hand-knotted
> Persian rugs, in the trade since 1866, founded from Kashan and rooted in Qom, Iran.
> The site is a catalog-and-inquiry gallery: every rug lists its reference (SKU),
> dimensions in centimetres, collection, material, origin, and a color palette
> extracted from its photographs. Prices are on request — there is no online checkout.
> Inquiries go by WhatsApp, phone, email (info@arsalanirug.com), or the contact form.
> Locations: Tehran Grand Bazaar (Bazar Booali Sara), Qom (Bazar Amjadi Sara),
> Izmir (Türkiye), and Los Angeles (USA).

The site ships in nine languages: English (default, at /), Persian (/fa/, RTL),
Turkish (/tr/), Spanish (/es/), Japanese (/ja/), German (/de/), Russian (/ru/),
Arabic (/ar/, RTL), and Chinese (/zh/).

## Catalog

- [The Collection](https://arsalanirug.com/products): all rugs, filterable by material
- [Categories](https://arsalanirug.com/categories/boutique-rugs): boutique-rugs,
  oushak, moshk-abad, new-moshk-abad, patch-work, selected-available-rugs
- Individual rugs live at /content/<slug>, e.g.
  [Qom Lachak Torang Gerd](https://arsalanirug.com/content/arsalani-qom-lachak-torang-gerd)
- Specialties: Qom silk (zarcharak and zaronim sizes, silk warp), Kashan old
  Manchester-wool pieces, Malayer boteh, Shiraz gabbeh, Oushak, Moshk Abad

## Learn

- [A Woven History](https://arsalanirug.com/history): the Persian rug from the Pazyryk
  carpet (c. 400 BC) and the Sasanian Spring of Khosrow to the Safavid Ardabil carpet,
  Mohtasham Kashan, Qom's 20th-century rise, and UNESCO's 2010 listing
- [How to Read a Persian Rug](https://arsalanirug.com/guide): motifs (lachak-toranj,
  boteh, herati, gol farang, kheshti, gabbeh), weaving cities (Qom and Kashan
  profiled), how to judge quality (raj/knot density, kork wool, abrash), and a
  weaver's lexicon of trade terms
- [Our Heritage](https://arsalanirug.com/about): the Arsalani family story — five
  generations from Gholamhossein Arsalani (b. Kashan, 1866) to today

## Contact

- [Contact](https://arsalanirug.com/contact): locations, phone, WhatsApp, form
